title: Shell Chrome Module Overview
description: The shell layer provides UI components for the Schematify app interface.
body: The shell components draw the application chrome: breadcrumb navigation, toolbar, outline panel with section switching, dock with collapsible tabs, status bar with 5 cells, inspector sidebar, facet palette, empty states, problems panel, and runs panel. Each component receives data and callbacks from App.tsx, applying pure presentational logic per PRD Wave specs.
